title: Deep learning classifies FDG-PET-CT scans of lymphoma patients across two centres
summary: A ResNet34-based model (LARS) was trained on 16,583 FDG-PET-CT scans from 5072 lymphoma patients at Memorial Sloan Kettering to separate Deauville 1-3 from 4-5, using 80% for training and 20% for testing. In the internal test set (3325 scans) AUC was 0.949 for LARS-avg, and in an external set of 1000 scans from the Medical University of Vienna AUC was 0.953, accuracy 0.907, sensitivity 0.874 and specificity 0.949. The analysis is retrospective and the tool classifies scans rather than replacing clinical assessment.
ai_technology: ResNet34-based deep-learning classifier (LARS) on PET-CT maximum intensity projections and 3D data
